cohort: The study cohort consisted of 229 patients admitted to a single center from 2013 to 2019 with early (<34 weeks) preeclampsia with severe features (ESPEC).
finding: Among patients with ESPEC attempting vaginal delivery, success was achieved less than half of the time, with BMI >= 40 associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery and private insurance associated with reduced odds of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Only 43% of ESPEC patients who attempted vaginal delivery were successful, and BMI >= 40 kg/m2 was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery while private insurance was associated with reduced odds of cesarean delivery.
